provenance: Native FreeCAD Body Tip shapes transformed once to global coordinates; rotating solids re-cut at every pose. Fixed camera and section plane.

focus-kicker: 电动内对焦实验 · F35 F2.8
focus-title: 转动输入齿轮，看第二片怎样移动
Turn the input gear and watch L2 move
focus-intro: 绿色输入齿轮驱动金色凸轮环；凸轮环轴向固定，只旋转。滚子带动蓝色镜座与 L2 平移，其他镜片不动。
The green input pinion drives the gold cam ring, which rotates at a fixed axial position. Followers translate the blue cell and L2; the other lenses stay fixed.
focus-teal: 固定筒及其余镜片：不动
focus-caption: 80:16 齿轮副 · 凸轮 ±40° · L2 ±2 mm。输入齿轮转角为凸轮的 −5 倍。21 个原生 CAD 姿态采用同一个剖切平面与视角，动画不代表实际对焦距离。
80:16 gearing · cam ±40° · L2 ±2 mm. Input rotation is −5 times the cam angle. The 21 native CAD poses share one section plane and camera. These positions are not calibrated focus distances.
focus-step1: 16 齿输入齿轮带动 80 齿凸轮环；凸轮环被轴向捕获，输入驱动只示意几何接口。
A 16-tooth input pinion drives the 80-tooth cam ring. The ring is captured axially; the input demonstrates a geometric drive interface.
focus-step2: 三组滚子沿闭口凸轮槽运动，把转角变成第二片的轴向行程。行程使用端点斜率为零的平滑曲线。
Three followers engage closed cam slots, converting rotation into axial L2 travel. The smoothstep travel law has zero slope at both endpoints.
focus-step3: 肩轴穿过固定筒直槽，使镜座只轴向移动。固定后组采用外缘接触、隔圈与单只后压圈装配。
Shoulder axles pass through straight housing slots, keeping the cell from rotating. Fixed rear optics use rim contact, a spacer and one rear cap.
focus-scope: 这是未选马达的几何驱动 demo。L3～L6 的新机械外缘需要新制镜片；光阑表面遮光环仅为待校核标注。尚未标定对焦距离；动画不代替通光、应力、公差或回差校核。

This geometric drive demo does not select a motor. New L3–L6 mechanical rims require new lens blanks. A lens-surface opaque aperture is indicated pending optical validation. Focus distances are uncalibrated; animation does not replace optical, stress, tolerance or backlash checks.
focus-footer: 仅 L2 移动，其余镜片固定；网页动画不操作本地 CAD 文件。
Only L2 moves; all other lenses stay fixed. The animation does not operate local CAD files.
